purpose: Prepare the high-impact non-reaping work before adding a seasonal solver or low-impact logistics mechanism.
inputs: Only the qualified fixed cereal-activity packet and existing Columella2.12 task transcription/calendar qualification notes. Use actual retained hectares and same physical workers; no new crop, climate, food, route or population run.
method: Decompose normative field operations per retained hectare into ploughing, harrowing, hoeing/weeding and reaping using the existing task counts and assumed8h/0.25ha conversions. Keep normative operation demand separate from the canonical rounded annual/reaping work and preserve their signed residual, rather than silently redistributing it. Market-share scenarios alias physical demands. Explain the single-barley result; no historical crop-mix adoption.
diagnostic: For each task and origin with a positive workforce, report required hours per worker and equivalent full8-hour-worker days. These are threshold allocation requirements if ALL that workforce were supplied, not reconstructed workdays, machine/team capacity or a feasible calendar. Reaping is a subset, not an additional annual charge. Undefined workers remain undefined, not zero required days.
evidence: Identify which task boundaries, human/draft services, competing activities and climate-compatible windows are missing. Existing Roman prescriptions are not empirical full farm occupations. Do not date tasks from an unresolved digital calendar witness or invent universal non-reaping windows.
decision: Choose one constrained next task/resource-window implementation or one finite period-evidence definition needed for a defensible seasonal baseline. Large annual demand should guide the choice, not which mechanism is easiest to parameterize.
exclusions: No new scenario sweep, parameter fit, new source family, warehouse staff, modern handling evidence, complete diet/occupation claim, reserved pools/workbook, atlas/default adoption or climate development.
